title: Check commands: a quoted | is not a pipe, and the implementer may run rg
lead: The Check classifier that sorts Check commands into implementer-runnable and orchestrator-only reads quotes the way ork's own check runner does, so a `|`, `&`, `;`, `<` or `>` inside single or double quotes no longer makes a command compound. The implementer presets do not gain `rg`: an `rg` Check line stays orchestrator-only.
findings_note: 2026-11-17: the spec check flagged orchestrator-only Check lines on S402, S396, S397, S390, S332 and S388, the same question as adj 249, 255, 256 and 259. Two causes: `checkCommandRunnable` (`internal/engine/brief.go:546-552`) treats any `;|&<>` or backtick or `$` as a compound command even inside quotes, so `go test ./internal/daemon -run 'A|B' -v` is orchestrator-only, while `plainCheckSyntax` (`internal/engine/brief.go:486-522`), which decides what ork itself runs, already accepts a quoted `|`. And `ImplementerPreset` (`internal/engine/perm.go:45-71`) has no `rg` entry, so every `rg -n ...` Check line is orchestrator-only.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner rule (2026-11-17): a deterministic step done regularly is code, not a model call or a hand step. Each spec check of a slice whose Check uses `go test -run 'A|B'` raises an owner question about orchestrator-only lines (adj 249, 255, 256, 259, and six more slices on 2026-11-17). The commands are plain and safe; the classifier is what makes them orchestrator-only.

Owner decisions (2026-11-17): ork is fixed in code first, and S402, S396, S397, S390, S332 and S388 wait until this slice lands [checks.implementer-runnable, adj 456]. The implementer presets do not allow `Bash(rg *)`: adj 457 supersedes adj 455 (launch.allowlist-rg), so `rg` Check lines stay orchestrator-only.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/brief.go:486-565` (`plainCheckSyntax`, new `shellSyntaxOutsideQuotes`, `checkCommandRunnable`: quote-aware compound test)
- `internal/engine/brief_test.go`
- `docs/design.md:1576-1584` (check classification)
- `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased entry, by hand: slicer changelog is off)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestCheckCommandRunnableQuotedPipe` in `internal/engine/brief_test.go`: with the `go` preset as allow, `go test ./internal/daemon -run 'MergedSpecCleanup|MergedCommitStopped' -v` and `go test ./internal/cli -run "SpecQuestion|PromptWraps" -v` are runnable; `go test ./... | tee out` and `go test ./... && rm -rf x` are not.
- `TestCheckCommandRunnableRgStaysOrchestratorOnly` in `internal/engine/brief_test.go`: `rg -n "adj 416" docs/boundaries.md` is not runnable under the built-in default or either preset (owner dropped rg, adj 457).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In `checkCommandRunnable`, replace the two `strings.ContainsAny(command, ";|&<>\n`$")` tests with a helper that reports shell syntax outside quotes, built on the same scan as `plainCheckSyntax` (single quotes literal; inside double quotes only `$` and backtick count). A command with unquoted `;|&<>`, a newline, `$` or a backtick keeps today's rule (needs an explicit whole-command allowlist form).
2. Update `docs/design.md` (check classification paragraph) to state the quote rule.
3. Add an Unreleased CHANGELOG entry by hand (`slicer changelog add` is off for this project).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- A Check line with a quoted pipe, such as go test -run 'A|B', is classified implementer-runnable in the role brief.
- A Check line with an unquoted pipe, redirect, ';' or '&&' stays orchestrator-only unless an allowlist form names the whole command.
- An rg Check line stays orchestrator-only under the built-in default and both presets.
- A spec check of S402 no longer lists 'go test ./internal/daemon -run ...' as orchestrator-only.
- docs/design.md states the quote rule.

Commands:
- `go test ./internal/engine -run CheckCommandRunnable -v`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` must print nothing.
